---
title: "The Five-Model Comparator"
subtitle: "One engagement, priced five ways"
---

Pick a single engagement below — how many people it replaces, how much work it does, how
much value it creates — then watch what the customer pays each month under **all five
pricing models at once**. Nothing about the *product* changes between the bars. Only the
**commercial model** changes.

The dashed line is what the customer pays for the **humans today**. Anything below it is a
saving you can share; anything above it needs a very good value story.

## Set up the engagement

```{ojs}
//| label: primary-inputs
viewof fteCost   = Inputs.range([30000, 120000], {value: 60000, step: 1000, label: "Human FTE cost (£/yr, fully loaded)"})
viewof fteCount  = Inputs.range([1, 20],          {value: 3,     step: 1,    label: "FTEs replaced / augmented"})
viewof volume    = Inputs.range([100, 10000],     {value: 1000,  step: 100,  label: "Tasks delivered per month"})
viewof aiCost    = Inputs.range([0.1, 10],        {value: 2,     step: 0.1,  label: "AI cost to serve one task (£)"})
viewof value     = Inputs.range([5000, 500000],   {value: 50000, step: 5000, label: "Business value created per month (£)"})
viewof riskScore = Inputs.range([1, 10],          {value: 5,     step: 1,    label: "Risk score (1–10)"})
viewof autonomy  = Inputs.select(["L1", "L2", "L3", "L4", "L5"], {value: "L3", label: "Autonomy level"})
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Fine-tune each model (optional)"}

```{ojs}
//| label: model-assumptions
viewof seatDiscount = Inputs.range([0.4, 0.7],   {value: 0.5,  step: 0.05, label: "M1 · seat discount vs human rate"})
viewof m2Margin     = Inputs.range([0.30, 0.50], {value: 0.40, step: 0.01, label: "M2 · target margin"})
viewof m2BaseFee    = Inputs.range([0, 5000],    {value: 500,  step: 100,  label: "M2 · monthly base fee (£)"})
viewof m3Margin     = Inputs.range([0.20, 0.70], {value: 0.40, step: 0.05, label: "M3 · target margin"})
viewof m4BaseFee    = Inputs.range([0, 30000],   {value: 8000, step: 500,  label: "M4 · base platform fee (£/mo)"})
viewof m4Share      = Inputs.range([0.01, 0.03], {value: 0.02, step: 0.005,label: "M4 · value share"})
viewof m5Share      = Inputs.range([0.02, 0.05], {value: 0.03, step: 0.005,label: "M5 · value share"})
viewof ceilMult     = Inputs.range([3, 5],       {value: 4,    step: 0.5,  label: "M5 · ceiling (× floor)"})
```

:::

```{ojs}
//| label: engine
//| echo: false

// ---- risk & autonomy overlay (applied on top of every input-based model) ----
riskPremium = (score) => {
  const pts = [[1, 0.05], [3, 0.10], [6, 0.20], [8, 0.40], [10, 1.00]];
  if (score <= 1) return 0.05;
  if (score >= 10) return 1.00;
  for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
    const [x0, y0] = pts[i], [x1, y1] = pts[i + 1];
    if (score >= x0 && score <= x1) return y0 + (y1 - y0) * (score - x0) / (x1 - x0);
  }
}
autonomyMod = (lvl) => (lvl === "L4" ? 1.20 : lvl === "L5" ? 1.40 : 1.00);
overlay = (base) => base * (1 + riskPremium(riskScore)) * autonomyMod(autonomy);

humanMonthly = fteCount * fteCost / 12;

prices = {
  const m1 = overlay(fteCount * (fteCost / 12) * seatDiscount);
  const m2 = overlay(m2BaseFee + volume * (aiCost / (1 - m2Margin)));
  const m3 = overlay(volume * (aiCost / (1 - m3Margin)));
  const m4 = overlay(m4BaseFee + value * m4Share);

  // M5 has its own floor/ceiling guardrails rather than the overlay
  const m4BaseOverlaid = overlay(m4BaseFee);
  const floor   = 0.8 * m4BaseOverlaid;
  const ceiling = ceilMult * floor;
  const m5raw   = value * m5Share;
  const m5      = Math.max(floor, Math.min(ceiling, m5raw));
  const m5bind  = m5raw <= floor ? "floor binds" : m5raw >= ceiling ? "ceiling binds" : "share applies";

  return [
    {model: "M1 Per Seat", price: m1, note: `${(seatDiscount*100).toFixed(0)}% of human rate`},
    {model: "M2 Usage",    price: m2, note: `${volume.toLocaleString()} tasks × unit price`},
    {model: "M3 Task",     price: m3, note: `${volume.toLocaleString()} tasks × task price`},
    {model: "M4 Hybrid",   price: m4, note: `base + ${(m4Share*100).toFixed(1)}% of value`},
    {model: "M5 Outcome",  price: m5, note: m5bind},
  ];
}

gbp = (x) => "£" + Math.round(x).toLocaleString("en-GB");
palette = ["#3DC7FF", "#0073E6", "#663894", "#AA4B8B", "#EF5E82"];
```

## What the customer pays each month

```{ojs}
//| label: chart
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 70,
  marginBottom: 40,
  height: 380,
  x: {label: null, domain: prices.map(d => d.model)},
  y: {label: "↑ Monthly price to customer (£)", grid: true,
      tickFormat: (s) => "£" + (s / 1000) + "k"},
  color: {domain: prices.map(d => d.model), range: palette},
  marks: [
    Plot.barY(prices, {x: "model", y: "price", fill: "model",
      tip: {format: {y: gbp, fill: false}}}),
    Plot.text(prices, {x: "model", y: "price", text: (d) => gbp(d.price),
      dy: -8, fontWeight: "bold"}),
    Plot.ruleY([humanMonthly], {stroke: "#00005C", strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: "5 4"}),
    Plot.text([`Human cost today  ·  ${gbp(humanMonthly)}/mo`],
      {frameAnchor: "top-right", dx: -6, dy: 8, fill: "#00005C", fontWeight: "bold"}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| label: insight
//| echo: false
{
  const ps = prices.map(d => d.price);
  const lo = Math.min(...ps), hi = Math.max(...ps);
  const loModel = prices.find(d => d.price === lo).model;
  const hiModel = prices.find(d => d.price === hi).model;
  return html`<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip">
    <div class="callout-body" style="padding:0.8em 1em;">
      <strong>Same engagement, ${(hi / lo).toFixed(1)}× price spread.</strong>
      From <strong>${gbp(lo)}/mo</strong> (${loModel}) to <strong>${gbp(hi)}/mo</strong> (${hiModel})
      — changing nothing but the pricing model. Annualised, that is
      ${gbp(lo * 12)} vs ${gbp(hi * 12)}.
    </div></div>`;
}
```

## The detail

```{ojs}
//| label: table
//| echo: false
Inputs.table(prices.map(d => ({
  Model: d.model,
  "Monthly (£)": gbp(d.price),
  "Annual (£)": gbp(d.price * 12),
  "vs human": (d.price / humanMonthly * 100).toFixed(0) + "%",
  Basis: d.note
})), {rows: 6, layout: "auto"})
```

## How each bar is calculated

The risk and autonomy settings apply on top of the four input-based models as a single
overlay — this is the framework's "apply the premium *on top of* the model price" rule:

$$\text{overlay}(x) = x \times \big(1 + \text{risk premium}\big) \times \text{autonomy modifier}$$

where the risk premium runs from +5% (score 1) to +100% (score 10), and the autonomy
modifier is ×1.00 up to L3, **×1.20 at L4**, and **×1.40 at L5**.

| Model | Monthly price (before overlay) |
|---|---|
| **M1 Per Seat** | $\text{FTEs} \times \dfrac{\text{FTE cost}}{12} \times \text{seat discount}$ |
| **M2 Usage** | $\text{base fee} + \text{volume} \times \dfrac{\text{AI cost}}{1 - \text{margin}}$ |
| **M3 Task** | $\text{volume} \times \dfrac{\text{AI cost}}{1 - \text{margin}}$ |
| **M4 Hybrid** | $\text{base fee} + \text{value} \times \text{share \%}$ |
| **M5 Outcome** | $\max\big(\text{floor},\ \min(\text{ceiling},\ \text{value} \times \text{share \%})\big)$ |

M5 uses guardrails instead of the overlay: the **floor** is 80% of the (overlaid) M4 base
fee — protecting your cost recovery — and the **ceiling** is a multiple of that floor,
capping the customer's exposure. Push the *business value* slider up and watch M5 climb off
its floor, then slam into its ceiling: that is the whole story of outcome-based pricing in
one slider.

::: {.callout-warning collapse="true"}
## These numbers are illustrative
The constants here are chosen to teach the shape of each model, not to quote a deal. Real
engagements need the CoE templates, an audited baseline, and the token-distribution work
from the next module.
:::
